scope: Synthetic authored planning examples, not executable Mstudio requests or model results. Inputs are manifests only; there are no image/video bytes.

cases.brief: Create one hero still of an invented silver audio device with a matte face. Keep the metal edge legible; no speculative logo.
cases.prompt: A single full-frame close three-quarter view of an invented audio device. Separate the curved metal edge from its matte face with a narrow side-rear strip reflection and restrained front fill. Leave a silhouette gap between the device and its case. Keep the brightest background patch away from the bright edge, with clean negative space on the right. The matte face stays softly textured rather than glossy; no decorative particle field or invented lettering.

cases.brief: A synthetic test portrait has the selected composition but muddy side lighting. Repair lighting, not the person or the whole scene.

inputs.edit-target: fixture-only portrait manifest; not an uploaded asset

cases.prompt: Edit the supplied synthetic portrait while retaining the selected framing, pose and face identity. Replace the muddy fill with restrained lateral light that separates the cheek contour from the background, keeping the opposite side readable. Preserve the existing background geometry and expression. Keep skin texture natural; do not invent accessories, a new face or a new camera angle. The change is the lighting relationship, not a blue colour wash.

cases.brief: A synthetic drink can gains frost on its lower body and sides; its label must remain readable, not pixel-identical.
cases.prompt: Begin from the supplied locked three-quarter can view. Fine frost starts at the lower rim and branches upward along the lower body and side edges. A visible growth front moves over the metal; unpassed regions retain condensation. Branches thicken into a thin translucent frost layer and stop before the bare label. Keep the can rim and silhouette consistent. Ice edges catch the existing side-rear strip reflection. Growth settles, a few water droplets slide on the unfrosted surface, and the camera holds the completed view without fog hiding the product.

cases.brief: For an explicitly requested standalone effect shot, make an outer paper wrapper disintegrate to reveal the intact product.
cases.prompt: From the supplied standalone opening frame, small fibrous flakes detach from the outer paper wrapper. The wrapper loses material at an advancing edge, progressively revealing the intact product beneath. Flakes drift away from the product label and settle as their density falls. Keep the product construction, existing light and locked camera stable. End with the product exposed and only a few residual flakes; do not leave an intact duplicate wrapper concealed by decorative particles.

cases.brief: Melt the whole product into a puddle while keeping its original silhouette completely unchanged.
cases.reason: Whole-object melting conflicts with the locked silhouette. Resolve the scope; do not silently melt only the background or send contradictory instructions.

cases.brief: Make a smoke transition from the outgoing product clip to the next scene; only the outgoing clip is supplied.
cases.reason: The incoming material is missing. Obtain the second endpoint before designing coverage and reveal; a smoke overlay is not the completed two-shot transition.

cases.brief: Use this selected four-panel board unchanged; the selected endpoint supports only an exact first frame.
cases.reason: The chosen endpoint lacks board-reference support. Do not put a grid into its first-frame field, crop cells, switch models or add paid control frames without authorization.

cases.brief: Retain every motion in an existing clip and add a light trail; the endpoint only supports appearance references.
cases.reason: Appearance-reference generation is not verified video editing. Preserve the requested source-motion requirement and report the route gap before a paid call.

cases.brief: Make a geographically specific, one-take ground-to-space pullback; no image of the named starting location is supplied.
cases.reason: The required location anchor is missing. Request the needed input and evaluate the route; do not invent verified geography or hide unauthorized bridge cuts. This is not a claim that all one-take routes are impossible.
